name: [🌷] Spelling Bee
desc:
Warning: Audio is required to hear the words!! 🔊

Compete against other people in this fast-paced spelling minigame.
Can you prove yourself to be the best at spelling, and can you type them before the clock runs out?

Current word count: 960

Rules:
- No exploiting, scripts or macros
- No harassment or bullying
- Do not share lists of the in-game words
